Affiliate disclosure

How we make money

Some links on Nestward — to resorts, hotels, and products we review — are affiliate links. If you click through and book or buy something, we may earn a small commission from the retailer or booking partner. This costs you nothing extra.

This doesn't change our recommendations. We don't accept payment in exchange for a positive review or a spot in a roundup, and resorts or products can't buy their way onto our lists. Where we have a direct relationship with a brand — such as receiving a product to test — we say so on the relevant page.

Any "Where to book" or "Where to buy" box on a page will carry this same disclosure, so it's never buried — you'll see it right next to the link itself.

Questions about a specific link or partnership?Get in touch.
